label: PF Backlog 73
title: BUG: DefectLoop.route_stage_issues -> 'IssueList' object is not iterable
body: Observed live 3x at finalization: '[DefectLoop] route_stage_issues: 'IssueList' object is not iterable'. core/defect_loop.route_stage_issues() iterates an IssueList wrapper without unpacking/iterating properly. Fix: iterate the IssueList's items (or make IssueList iterable).
